Lord '''Ellisar''' is a commander during the [[Aiel War]].

==History==
Lord Ellisar had a camp near [[Tar Valon]]. [[Willa Mandair]] gives birth to her son, [[Bili Mandair|Bili]], in his camp.{{ref/book|0|6}}
